info.title: Naver Open API Specification (English)
info.description: Comprehensive OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification for Naver Open API Platform translated into English.

get.description: Blog Search API provided by Naver Platform

rss.description: RSS container. You can check search results using an RSS reader.

rss/channel.description: A container that contains search results. The sub-elements of the channel element, such as title, link, and description, are information used in RSS and have nothing to do with search results.

rss/channel/lastBuildDate.description: Time when search results were generated

rss/channel/display.description: Number of search results to display at once

rss/channel/item.description: Individual search results. Results in JSON format return individual search results as a JSON array in the items property.

rss/channel/item/title.description: Title of the blog post. The part of the title that matches the search term is wrapped in tags.

rss/channel/item/description.description: Passage information that summarizes the content of the blog post. The part of the passage information that matches the search term is wrapped in tags.

rss/channel/item/bloggername.description: Name of the blog where the blog post is located

rss/channel/item/bloggerlink.description: Address of the blog where the blog post is located

rss/channel/item/postdate.description: Date the blog post was created

400.description: Bad Request - Missing mandatory query parameter or invalid parameter value

404.description: Not Found - Invalid request URL path

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search term. It must be encoded as UTF-8.

parameters.name: display
parameters.description: Number of search results to display at once (default: 10, maximum: 100)

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Search start position (default: 1, maximum: 1000)

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: How to sort search results - sim: Sort descending by accuracy (default) - date: Sort descending by date

rss/channel/item/title.description: Title of news article. The part of the title that matches the search term is wrapped in tags.

get.description: Shopping Search API provided by Naver Platform

rss.description: RSS container. You can check search results using an RSS reader.

rss/channel.description: A container that contains search results. The sub-elements of the channel element, such as title, link, and description, are information used in RSS and have nothing to do with search results.

rss/channel/lastBuildDate.description: Time when search results were generated

rss/channel/display.description: Number of search results to display at once

rss/channel/item.description: Individual search results. Results in JSON format return individual search results as a JSON array in the items property.

rss/channel/item/title.description: Product name. The part of the name that matches the search term is wrapped in tags.

rss/channel/item/lprice.description: Lowest price. If there is no lowest price information, it returns 0. If price comparison data is not available, this refers to the product price.

rss/channel/item/hprice.description: Highest price. Returns 0 if there is no highest price information or no price comparison data.

rss/channel/item/mallName.description: A shopping mall that sells products. If there is no shopping mall information, Naver is returned.

rss/channel/item/productType.description: Product type according to product group and product type. For product types according to product group and product type, refer to the table of product group types. - Product group: general product, used product, discontinued product, product scheduled for sale - Product type: price comparison product, price comparison non-matching general product, price comparison matching general product

400.description: Bad Request - Missing mandatory query parameter or invalid parameter value

404.description: Not Found - Invalid request URL path

startDate.description: The query period start date (in yyyy-mm-dd format). You can search starting January 1, 2016.

timeUnit.description: Section unit - date: daily - week: weekly - month: monthly

keywordGroups.description: An array of pairs of keywords and search term bundles corresponding to the keywords. Up to 5 pairs can be set up in an array.

keywordGroups.groupName.description: Key word. This is a name that represents a group of search terms.

keywordGroups.keywords.description: Search term corresponding to the topic. Up to 20 search terms can be set as an array.

device.description: range. Conditions based on the search environment. - Not set: All environments - pc: Search trends on PC - mo: Search trends on mobile

gender.description: gender. Conditions based on the gender of the search user. - Not set: All genders - m: Male - f: Female

ages.description: years. Conditions based on the age of the search user. - Not set: All ages - 1: 0 to 12 years - 2: 13 to 18 years - 3: 19 to 24 years - 4: 25 to 29 years - 5: 30 to 34 years - 6: 35 to 39 years - 7: 40 to 44 years - 8: 45 to 49 years - 9: 50 to 54 years - 10: 55-59 years old - 11: 60 years old or older

code.description: Authentication code returned when Naver login authentication is successful, used to issue an access token

state.description: URL-encoded value with an application-generated state token to prevent cross-site request forgery attacks.

access_token.description: Access token expires after the number of seconds set in the expires_in parameter after issuance.

refresh_token.description: Renew token, used to reissue an access token when the access token expires

token_type.description: Supports two types of access tokens: Bearer and MAC.

expires_in.description: Validity period of access token (in seconds)
